LESSON: PACKAGED FOOD EDUCATION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Safety Education
Topic 4.1: Packaged food Education

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Packaged food Education. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how can these dangers in nose bleeding uneven pavements, open the school be prevented?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Packaged food Education
2. Practise Packaged food Education at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Packaged food Education

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Packaged food Education
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Packaged food Education. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Packaged food Education at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Packaged food Education at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Packaged food Education
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Packaged food Education. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Packaged food Education using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Packaged food Education in the examples.
2. Explain Packaged food Education to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Packaged food Education.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Packaged food Education using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Packaged food Education important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups, learners listen to stories and share experiences of common accidents they have encountered or witnessed in the school.
2. Tell how they can prevent common accidents in the school using demonstration, pictures and illustrations.
3. Tell the First Aid for fainting and nose bleeding.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Packaged food Education
2. Practise Packaged food Education at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Packaged food Education

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
